review_views.label: 全体構図
review_views.evidence: Base, raw, protected final, topology guide, hachure skeleton, masks, automated report, and diagnostic crops were independently inspected.
review_views.notes: Two main relief fields remain, but the requested six-landform hierarchy is not readable.

review_views.label: 原寸100%
review_views.evidence: The 1536x1024 protected final was inspected at native scale.
review_views.notes: Four foothills are absent as independent terrain, while repeated bright-centered radial mounds dominate both main relief fields.

review_views.label: 200%・400%拡大
review_views.evidence: Raw/final crops under tmp/map-production/g3-review-v1 were inspected at original detail.
review_views.notes: NE-west, SE-west, and SE-east foothills disappear or become faint substrate; NE-central survives only as noisy fragments among rock marks.

review_views.label: 中央・四隅・四辺の9領域
review_views.evidence: The full raw, final, masks, and difference image were scanned across the center, corners, and edges.
review_views.notes: Outer borders are restored exactly, while internal permission and road-protection boundaries remain visually abrupt.

review_views.label: 制御図との半透明重ね合わせ
review_views.evidence: All six skeleton components were compared with raw and final per-landform diagnostics.
review_views.notes: The deterministic guide has six structures, but ImageGen converts them to repeated convergent mounds and the broad protection mask erases most foothill signal.

review_views.label: 親ズーム画像との比較
review_views.evidence: Candidate D v4 and G3 were compared at matching extents and reduced visual scale.
review_views.notes: Paper and palette continue, but bright-centered pseudo-3D mounds and loss of secondary terrain break the parent-child hierarchy.

review_views.label: 四方向の隣接合成
review_views.evidence: All border metrics are zero and edge/road-adjacent crops were inspected.
review_views.notes: Canvas edges are safe, but 64px road guards produce broad flat internal channels and clipped relief.

review_views.label: ベクターラベル・道路・POI重畳
review_views.evidence: Roads, cities, coast, forest, fields, future label space, and protected pixel evidence were reviewed.
review_views.notes: Canonical linework is exact; dense radial relief and road-shaped voids weaken overlay readability.

review_views.label: Leafletデスクトップ表示
review_views.evidence: Desktop suitability was assessed from native and enlarged views without staging a rejected raster.
review_views.notes: Repeated rosette terrain marks remain conspicuous at normal desktop scale.

review_views.label: Leafletモバイル表示
review_views.evidence: Mobile suitability was assessed from the reduced overview without staging a rejected raster.
review_views.notes: Only two dark main fields survive; foothills and saddles are not navigationally useful.

immediate_failures.label: 海岸線・河川・主要道路・城壁の移動
immediate_failures.evidence: Automated gates report zero changed pixels outside permission, on road cores, on detail cores, wherever the mask is zero, and on all four borders.

immediate_failures.label: 必須地点・地形の欠落
immediate_failures.evidence: All four required foothills fail independent recognition in the final, and the two-rise plus open-saddle hierarchy is unclear in both main relief fields.

immediate_failures.label: 正典外の主要都市・施設
immediate_failures.evidence: No new city, facility, transport route, or major landmark was introduced.

immediate_failures.label: AI生成文字・記号
immediate_failures.evidence: No generated words, pseudo-labels, legend, compass, scale, signature, or route-like marks were found.

immediate_failures.label: 目視できる継ぎ目
immediate_failures.evidence: Relief stops abruptly at the broad north-east and south-east road guards, leaving flat channels and visible permission-boundary cuts.

immediate_failures.label: 現代物・透かし・署名
immediate_failures.evidence: No modern object, watermark, logo, or signature was found.

immediate_failures.label: 遠近法化・縮尺の急変
immediate_failures.evidence: Bright centers with dark convergent slopes read as raised cones or top-lit volcanic mounds rather than flat, non-illuminated cartographic hachure.

immediate_failures.label: 建物・樹木・岩の不自然な反復
immediate_failures.evidence: Near-identical bright-centered radial starburst or fingerprint mounds repeat across both main relief fields.

scores.label: 正典・地形形状との一致
scores.notes: Protected canon is exact, but four foothills and clear saddle hierarchy are missing.

scores.label: 親子ズームの連続性
scores.notes: Palette continues; raised radial mounds and lost secondary terrain break the hierarchy.

scores.label: 隣接画像の継ぎ目
scores.notes: Outer edges are exact, but road and permission masks visibly cut internal relief.

scores.label: 画風・色・線密度
scores.notes: Historical color is compatible, while repeated convergent mounds violate the flat irregular-hachure grammar.

scores.label: 縮尺相応の情報量
scores.notes: Main fields are over-dense and four secondary landforms are unreadable.

scores.label: 生成破綻・反復模様
scores.notes: Radial repetition, bright centers, and mask-derived channels are dominant artifacts.

scores.label: ベクター重畳時の可読性
scores.notes: Protected vectors remain exact, but dense relief and flat gaps compete with overlays.

summary: G3 is rejected. The six-part skeleton is valid and protected canon stays pixel-exact, but four foothills disappear, radial bright-centered terrain glyphs repeat, pseudo-3D lighting returns, and road guards expose broad internal seams.
required_changes: Replace the broad road/detail protection strategy with a narrow canonical-line protection that preserves foothill support without moving any protected feature.
After protection is proven, replace all convergent bright-centered relief with non-radial, non-illuminated short unequal fall-line marks in a separate one-change attempt.
